interface.name: unity_preview_manager_v1
interface.description: Draws live windows into surfaces of the client. The client places, sizes, orders and synchronizes those surfaces with standard requests (wl_subsurface, wp_viewport); the compositor only draws the window.

request.name: get_preview

description.summary: draw a window into a surface

request.description: The compositor draws the window frame, without its client-side shadow, scaled to the size of the surface, above the surface's own content and clipped to the parent surface. If the window does not exist or is not mapped, the compositor sends closed at once.

arg.name: view_id
arg.summary: wayfire view id of the window

request.name: set_alpha
request.description: Applied on the next commit of the surface. Initial value 1.

event.name: closed
event.description: No more events follow; the compositor stops drawing into the surface.
